thread:
Samir (CS): short synthesis from onboarding + renewal calls. dropping compact list of asks we should triage this week.
Talia (CS): paste please, i'll call out immediate renewal flags.
Samir (CS): here's a trimmed CSV of the recurring items:
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
lynx,per-route-export,feature,high,wants CSV per-route for finance review (renewal in 4w)
monarch,team-roles,feature,high,need RBAC for project-level access, blocks rollout
aurora,embed-sweep,bug,medium,old vectors accumulate and inflate costs
shoreline,quota-alerts,feature,medium,wants webhook/email when spend ~80% budget
```
Talia (CS): lynx and monarch flagged renewal-high in their calls. both said they'd pause expansion without fixes.
Gabe (PM): monarch RBAC: do we have a design? could be console + API + org mapping.
Hannah (Eng): RBAC touches auth service + metadata. quick MVP: project-level roles + invite flow (no full policy language). estimate spike 5d, MVP 2w.
Gabe (PM): per-route-export sounds like a quick ship. what's smallest useful output?
Samir (CS): customers want per-route totals for last 30 days + sample request ids. CSV or S3 link OK. low-friction shows progress to finance teams.
Hannah (Eng): per-route CSV endpoint + background job to aggregate is doable. rough: spike 1d, ship MVP ~3d.
Talia (CS): can we use that as a pilot for the top 3 renewal-risk accounts? show action quickly.
Gabe (PM): yes. propose: ship per-route CSV as a CS pilot this sprint, start RBAC spike in next sprint, and queue quota-alerts for prioritization.
feedback-bot: created jira CS-5222 "per-route usage export (CS pilot)" assigned to @hannah.
Samir (CS): adding two direct quotes to the ticket: "We need a per-route ledger to reconcile our finance dashboard." and "If costs stay opaque we can't justify expansion."
Hannah (Eng): i'll pick up the spike today and post a POE with sample CSV schema. initial ACs i'll draft: 1) CSV with route, token_count, request_count, cost_estimate for last 30 days; 2) auth respects org scoping; 3) exports available via signed URL.
Gabe (PM): good. RBAC: i'll draft a short RFC and include migration notes for existing org owners. aim to present at next product sync.
Talia (CS): i'll notify Lynx & Monarch that we're piloting exports and that RBAC is in scope for next milestone. will offer staging preview.
Samir (CS): one more small ask: Aurora's embed-sweep is throwing noise. Hannah, can we add a maintenance job to TTL old vectors to reduce storage?
Hannah (Eng): agree, embed sweep can be an infra job. estimate 2 dev days to add TTL + backfill script.
Gabe (PM): let's batch small infra items into a maintenance sprint after this pilot ship.
Samir (CS): thanks team. i'll update the renewal playbook and ping legal for any export compliance notes. :sparkles:
